finish: If the Tech adds something, add it to Description in professional wording, save, and ask "Anything else?" Repeat until the Tech says no or that's it.
If nothing was ever added to Description, store `Interior Audit [Location]` there.
Call update_job with the line `Status: Complete` (exactly that, nothing after it) and `Current question: done`.

Send one message: the Data table (every field read from the Job description, in a table), a blank line, then the closing line "Got it. The weekly interior safety audit is saved in this job." Never send a summary instead of the table.
